goal: Run CI tests on BSD platforms to catch platform-specific regressions before merge
Prevent recurring BSD breakage that currently requires reactive fixes after nightly runs
reviewability: Review is worthwhile now as the rebase conflict with master is purely mechanical
agreement: Concept approval for running tests on at least one BSD platform (hebasto)
Concern that brittle nested VM tests could cause frequent false-positive CI failures is answered (maflcko)

categories.name: build
why: P3 because catching BSD regressions before merge prevents broken master builds and reactive fixes
The benefit is limited to BSD platform support rather than broader user-facing functionality
